notes: The support frame *put ... in remembrance of* is licensed by its own supplied noun, and the word it stands over, τὰς ὁδούς, is accusative. Rule 21 keeps such a preposition inside the verb's unit with the governed word bare, and rule 106's accusative arm says the same from the other side; the verse's own s016 already applied that test to ὑμᾶς, the other accusative of the same clause, and 1CO.4.1 applies it to ἡμᾶς after *account of*. Only s017 and s019 change: t026 (*of*) moves from the noun into the verb's unit. Every other edge, head and note is as the verse pass returned it.
